note: The 30 PoOlympics events (user rules, 2026-09-27). All unlocked from the start. Venue = Stadium.glb anchors E##_L0..E##_L7; build/status tracked in tasks.md Phase E.

events.name: The Iron Pedestal
events.rules: 8 athletes stand shoulder to shoulder on one narrow iron beam. Gusts shove them into each other; the last one still on the beam wins.

events.name: Sumo Ring
events.rules: 8 athletes spawn around a 2.9 m raised disc and charge inward. Push rivals off the ring or knock them down; last standing wins.

events.name: Narrow Bridge Crossing
events.rules: 4 athletes start on each end of a 1.44 m wide elevated bridge and race across head-on. First to cross without falling off wins.

events.name: Funnel Bottleneck Sprint
events.rules: 35 m sprint through two narrow 1.8 m chicane gates. Runners pile into the bottlenecks and fight through; fastest to finish wins.

events.name: The Gust Gauntlet
events.rules: All 8 share one shaker floor: lateral wind bursts push them into each other and the floor jolts everyone at once. Scored on recovery time back to your spot.

events.name: Figure-8 Crossroad Dash
events.rules: Two 4-runner packs sprint on perpendicular tracks intersecting at a shared central junction. Survive the cross-traffic collision and finish fastest.

events.name: Shrinking Safe-Zone
events.rules: Athletes roam an open arena until safe pads activate (7, 5, 3, 1). Race to claim a pad and block rivals out before the buzzer; last standing wins.

events.name: 30m All Fours
events.rules: 30 m race on hands and feet, crawlers side by side 1.1 m apart - bumping and tangling allowed. Falling never eliminates - get back on all fours and keep going; standing up is a DQ.

events.name: The Inverted Sprint
events.rules: 20m reverse sprint. Disqualification upon lane drifting or backward tumbling.

events.name: Center Beacon Scramble
events.rules: All 8 charge a single central 1.15 m beacon for 30 s. Score time inside the zone while shoving rivals out; highest hold time wins.

events.name: Slalom Sprint
events.rules: Mirror slalom: neighbouring lanes weave in opposite directions and meet at every other gate. Penalties added for missed gates or clipping flags.

events.name: The 360 Turntable
events.rules: 8 spin spots on one tight ring: turn 3 times without being knocked off your spot. Scored on speed and drift; pushed onto a neighbour's spot is a DQ.

events.name: Steeplechase Jog
events.rules: 50m sprint requiring sustained aerial flight phases between foot strikes; scored on ground time (finish time minus hang time).

events.name: The Alpine Ramp
events.rules: Ascending a 15-degree ramp straight into a finish sensor.

events.name: Cross-Country Rubble
events.rules: Traversal across randomized mounds and ruts.

events.name: The Platform Drop
events.rules: Rapid descent down stepped terrain; scored on descent speed and soft-landing dissipation.

events.name: Stadium Stair Climb
events.rules: 20-step vertical climb without catching toes on step lips.

events.name: Inside-Rail Pack Mile
events.rules: 84.39 m sprint where all 8 immediately squeeze onto the inside rail from 2 m. Continuous shoulder-to-shoulder pack contact to the finish.

events.name: Terminal Velocity Sprint
events.rules: Open sprint at top speed; past the green break line the field squeezes to the inside, shoulder to shoulder. Ranked by peak speed; a fall ranks last.

events.name: Low Hurdle Dash
events.rules: 30m sprint incorporating 0.3m hurdles requiring coordinated high-knee clearance.

events.name: The Sandpit Long Jump
events.rules: Run-up followed by forward horizontal launch into a sandpit.

events.name: Emergency Brake
events.rules: Full sprint toward a red stop line. Athletes must reach full standstill without crossing the boundary.

events.name: The Trench Crawl
events.rules: Low ceiling tunnel forcing all-fours crawl movement: 16 m on hands and feet under a 12 m trench ceiling 0.72 m high; standing up = DQ.

events.name: The Courier Carry
events.rules: Carry a weighted crate across 15m without dropping or pitching backward.

events.name: Hilltop Scramble
events.rules: Climb 4 converging ramps up to a raised 2.6 m summit platform and shove rivals off the edges. Highest summit time wins.

events.name: Stepping Stones
events.rules: Narrow elevated pads with zero room for error; miss-steps result in drop out.

events.name: The Resurrection Dash
events.rules: Athletes start flat on their backs; fastest to rise and sprint 5m wins.

events.name: Floor Acrobatic Sprint
events.rules: Full-body inversion across a gymnastics safety mat.

events.name: Striker Shootout
events.rules: Intercept a rolling soccer ball mid-stride and kick past a target marker.

events.name: The Grand Parkour Vault
events.rules: Multi-stage course: approach, wall vault, drop landing, and hurdle sprint.
